user_query: My friends and I are planning a game night and we want to include some jokes to keep the atmosphere lively. Can you provide a list of available joke categories from the Chuck Norris API and recommend some entertaining jokes from the Jokes by API-Ninjas API? Additionally, find some manatee jokes to make the game night more enjoyable.

TaskList.description: Fetch the available joke categories from the Chuck Norris API.
Fetch entertaining jokes from the Jokes by API-Ninjas API based on the joke categories received from Step 1.
Fetch manatee jokes from a suitable jokes API.
